subject: Mid-Q capacity rebalance: action items and rescope for QBR readiness
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Maria Gonzalez <maria@brightleafhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@cloudops.io>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-Q capacity rebalance: action items and rescope for QBR readiness

Team / Maria / Samir —

Quick summary up front: we have a projected GPU capacity shortfall for projected QBR demo load (~18% shortfall on peak 99th latency targets) if we keep both Initiative A (Realtime Reranking) and Initiative B (Full-context Multitenant Cache) at current scope. The attached QBR-readiness-matrix.xlsx and the rescope-proposal-v2.pdf lay out a recommended re-scope to preserve our top-line QBR commitments (demo latency & cost targets).

Ask: can leadership sign off on the proposed re-scope for Initiative B (defer large-scale multitenant cache rollout to post-QBR) and commit the following dependency support:
- Infrastructure: short-term burst capacity (2 dedicated nodes) for the week of Sept 7-13; automatic teardown after the demo window.
- Product: shrink Initiative A surface area to the priority 3 flows only (customer-facing reranking) rather than expanding to internal admin flows.
- CS / Customer validation: Marissa / Maria to confirm that BrightLeaf can accept the narrowed demo scope without jeopardizing renewal conversations.

I've flagged tradeoffs in the matrix and added cost/latency delta columns — see Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-QBR

Proposed next steps:
1) Leadership decision + owners assigned by EOD 8/19.
2) Tech runbook and infra request (JIRA-RT-6421) by 8/21.
3) Rehearsal + perf run on 9/8.

Attachments: QBR-readiness-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), rescope-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal)

Thanks — I tried to keep this actionable.

Connor O'Brien
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Mid-Q capacity rebalance: action items and rescope for QBR readiness

Connor — thanks for the concise brief and the matrix. A couple quick questions before I give a final sign-off:

1) The 2 dedicated nodes burst — is that an on-demand Dedicated allocation or are you proposing Dedicated-simulated capacity on Hosted with an SLA exemption? In other words, who owns the infra cost and the procurement window?
2) If we defer Initiative B, what’s the incremental latency impact on the demo flows (p95/p99) — the matrix shows p95, can you add p99 deltas?

Laura — can you confirm whether infra has capacity to spin the 2 nodes the week of Sept 7 and what impact that has on other Reserved commitments? If not, we need a fallback (Samir, can CloudOps provide short-term capacity?).

Also cc'ing Maria because this will change the demo script slightly (we will need to remove one scenario). Maria — is that acceptable from BrightLeaf's perspective for the customer-facing demo?

Vivek
CTO, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mid-Q capacity rebalance: action items and rescope for QBR readiness

Agree with Connor's recommended re-scope for Initiative B for the QBR window with the following caveats:

- Product will approve the narrowed Initiative A surface (priority 3 flows only) conditional on a user-acceptance test plan (UAT) that covers the critical reranking paths. We need a UAT checklist by 8/24.
- We should not cut any telemetry or alerting — ops must preserve diagnostic traces for post-demo root-cause analysis.
- Defer Initiative B but schedule an accelerated remediation sprint in Oct to recover the roadmap delta; I want a concrete recovery plan by 9/15.

Marissa / Maria — please confirm that BrightLeaf can sign off on the narrower demo script. If BrightLeaf needs the full flow to validate a workflow, we'll need to take a different approach (either a tailored private demo or additional infra).

Forwarded for visibility: excerpt from Connor's matrix attached.

Kimberly Park
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mid-Q capacity rebalance: action items and rescope for QBR readiness — decisions and owners

Thanks everyone — summary and owners below (decisions confirmed):

Decisions made:
- Defer Initiative B's large-scale multitenant cache for the QBR demo window. (approved)
- Narrow Initiative A to priority 3 customer flows only for the demo. (approved with UAT)
- Approve short-term burst capacity: 2 dedicated nodes, week of Sept 7-13, infra to own procurement and cost for Hosted fallback if Dedicated not available.

Action items (owner — due):
- Laura Bennett — submit infra request and confirm procurement approach (Dedicated vs Hosted fallback) and cost estimate (due 2026-08-21).
- Connor O'Brien — update JIRA-RT-6421 with p99 deltas and final runbook; attach final UAT checklist (due 2026-08-21).
- Marissa Cole — validate narrowed demo script with BrightLeaf and confirm acceptance via email (due 2026-08-21).
- Kimberly Park — deliver recovery sprint plan for Initiative B (due 2026-09-15).
- Marissa / Maria — schedule a short joint rehearsal week of 9/8 for the demo flows (proposed: 9/8 10:00 PT) and confirm attendees.

I've attached the updated matrix and a brief rescope PDF (see attachments). I'll book a 30-minute sync for 8/21 09:30 PT to walk through infra ask and any remaining open questions (calendar invite to follow).

Connor O'Brien
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
